bio_1: The creative engine behind the Babycakes aesthetic. Nile pioneered the brand's Handwritten Messaging concept — transforming the tray cake from a food item into a communication tool that Gen Z could share and make their own.
bio_2: The Soft Chocolate Baby Tray is built on a recipe from Nile's mother, made in 1999. She guards it personally to ensure quality never changes as the brand scales.
